To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the modified sieve method provides: (1) effective PPS sampling stratum properties, (2 ) accurate recognition of changes in stratum membership resulting from sample augmentation, (3) tight control over line item sampling risk, (4) tight and efficient control of sampling error bunching, and (5) precise control over line-item sample sizes.

(1) modified sieve sampling provides effective control over sample size and sampling risk, while maintaining sampling stratum PPs properties, (2 ) modified sieve sampling is well suited to multi-stage sampling applications where census stratum membership changes with sample augmentation, and, (3) the method is well adapted to single-stage sampling applications requiring control over sampling risk and sample size, particularly where tainting levels and sampling error bunching patterns are not known in advance.
